cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior - Medior AI-Driven Content & Visual Designer freelance mission. Your goal of building a light, streamlined content engine that combines Figma templates and AI tools to produce web and social content at speed is exactly the kind of work I thrive on. I use AI as a creative sidekick daily—not as a gimmick—and I love turning a brief into a sharp visual quickly.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage CMS content for multiple client websites, create and publish blog posts, and design social media visuals. I work within existing design systems and templates, ensuring consistency while iterating fast on feedback. My freelance projects, such as baverok.com and mirook.com, demonstrate my ability to deliver autonomously from brief to final asset. For baverok.com, I designed and built the site myself, including a hand-coded landing page with a WebGL hero. For mirook.com, I implemented structured data and ran technical SEO audits. These projects show my hands-on experience with web visuals and content production.

I have strong Figma skills, including components, variants, and auto-layout, and I'm proficient in using AI tools like ChatGPT and Claude for content generation, as well as Canva for quick visuals. I also have experience with prompt engineering and automating workflows using Python, which aligns with your bonus points for automating content workflows. My background in front-end development (AngularJS, JavaScript) and CMS platforms (WordPress, Shopify) gives me solid digital know-how for website integrations and optimisations.

I'm available immediately, fluent in English, and based in Belgium. I have a portfolio at baverok.com showcasing my work, including AI-assisted content and templates. I'm eager to bring my speed, smart workflows, and ownership to your team and help build a content engine that lasts.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to discussing how I can contribute.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
